## Purpose

Describe the recorded Jarvis failure and the proposed correction.

## Safety checklist

- [ ] A regression test reproduces the original failure.
- [ ] Existing tests pass.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or user data are included.
- [ ] No room/device safety rule is weakened.
- [ ] No Admin Mode or identity permission is weakened.
- [ ] No new dependency is introduced without review.
- [ ] Candidate container health check passed.
- [ ] Rollback reference is available.

## Evidence

Include the redacted failure ID, test results and changed files.
